public_rationale: The reporting is broadly consistent with losses and a substantial Microsoft profit entitlement. It does not establish the whole claim on a matching financial basis. A reported loss cannot automatically be treated as net income, and the evidence does not cover every relevant period. The accounting basis is also unspecified. The profit-sharing language requires qualifications about stages and duration. These gaps warrant unresolved rather than treating plausible reporting as complete verification.
limitations: The original loss report could not be read; the retained account is secondary.
No audited status is established for the reported figures.
The contract was not available for independent inspection.
Unknown accounting basis prevents a supported or contradicted financial verdict.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI has had no net profits so far, and roughly half of any future profits must be shared with Microsoft for a long time.

statement.excerpt: So far, there have been no net profits, and as noted above if there are any, for a long time roughly half must be shared with Microsoft, by contractual agreement.

our_interpretation: So far covers OpenAI's operating history through May 5, 2024; the source does not provide an inception date.
The ordinary reading is that OpenAI had not achieved positive net income, rather than merely having accumulated historical losses.
The Microsoft clause concerns obligations under the agreement then in force. It is not a prediction that profits necessarily would occur.
Roughly half permits a reported 49% share during a substantial distribution stage; it does not require the same percentage at every stage.
No accounting basis is identified in the supplied text. Press estimates cannot silently become company-reported or audited net income.
Future changes to the agreement would not establish what its terms were on the post date.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable financial records establish no positive net income through the post date, and the operative agreement establishes an approximately half share for Microsoft over a substantial future profit-distribution stage.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable records establish positive net income before the post, or the operative agreement is materially incompatible with the asserted substantial approximately half share.
